notes: Deliberately degraded scanned invoice (rotated, noisy, blurred, heavily JPEG-compressed, no text layer). In this run OCR happened to recover every value correctly, but the pipeline still routes ANY OCR-derived extraction below the confidence threshold to needs_review by design, because OCR text can look locally confident while being structurally wrong (e.g. a misread column header silently shifting values). This is the intended demonstration case: the system does not silently trust a scanned document just because individual words look fine.
